title: 第21章 偶遇圣女震惊的上官无情第22章 只是提醒女魔头真不是馋她身子
content_zh:
两个时辰后。
在充足阴气的滋润下，林陌终于顺利突破至炼气七重。
而那名筑基期女修，此时躺在床上，仿佛身体被掏空。
再反观林陌，由于再次突破的原因，整个人看上去容光焕发。
不仅如此。
他的手臂、脸庞、双腿以及上半身，仿佛在一夜之间年轻了十岁，不再像以前那样的干瘦如柴，仿佛一阵风就能把他吹飞。
捏了捏那已经有了些许肉感的手腕和大腿，林陌如沐春风，心情无比的愉悦。
“修仙真是这个世界最伟大的发明！”
前不久，他还只是一名行将就木，半只脚踏入棺材的迟暮老人。
然而，车到桥头必有路，柳暗花明又一村。
放在一个月前，林陌打死也不敢相信，自己居然还有逆袭的一天！
虽然他没有其他诸多穿越众的必备金手指系统，但纯阳圣体，几乎可以称作是天渊大陆最强的外挂了。
“幸亏有纯阳圣体，不然老夫怕是要被钉在穿越者的耻辱柱上了。”
林陌心中暗暗窃喜。
虽说他今年已经一百一十多了，但在修仙界，一百岁正是奋斗的年纪！
林陌坚信，只要努力修炼提升修为。
自己就算回不到二十岁时的模样，至少也可以回到中年时的模样。
这就已经足够了。
整理了一下心情，林陌离开了醉仙楼。
“距离上官无情说的十天，还有三天时间，正好回去休整一下。”

回到自己的小木屋，林陌迫不及待地试了一下炼气七重的力量。
跟炼气六重果然不在一个档次上。
只是...
突破到炼气七重，也让他的兜比脸都干净了。
“要不是柳紫嫣那女魔头设置了一个五千灵石的目标，接下来我还真不知道去哪里搞灵石...”
半躺在床头，林陌思忖道。
杂役弟子的身份，限制还是太多了。
林陌哪怕有心想搞灵石都搞不了。
初圣宗是设置有赚取灵石的宗门任务，但仅限内门弟子接取。
杂役是没有资格去接宗门任务的。
至于宗门历练就更不用说了。
杂役也想去参加宗门历练？做梦呢！
“将来还是得想办法从柳紫嫣那里多薅一点修炼资源。”
content_en:
Two hours later.
With sufficient nourishment of Yin Qi, Lin Mo finally successfully broke through to the seventh level of Qi refining.
And the female cultivator in the Foundation Establishment Stage was lying on the bed, as if her body had been hollowed out.
Looking back at Lin Mo, he looked radiant due to his breakthrough again.
Not only that.
His arms, face, legs and upper body seemed to have become ten years younger overnight, no longer as skinny as before, as if a gust of wind could blow him away.
After squeezing his wrists and thighs that were already a little fleshy, Lin Mo felt like a spring breeze and felt extremely happy.
"Cultivation of immortality is really the greatest invention in this world!"
Not long ago, he was just a dying old man with half a foot in the coffin.
However, there must be a road to Qiaotou, and there is another village with dark flowers and bright trees.
A month ago, Lin Mo couldn't believe it even to death, but he could still counterattack one day!
Although it does not have the golden finger system that many other time travelers have to have, Pure Yang Holy Body can almost be called the strongest plug-in in Tianyuan Continent.
"Thankfully I have the Pure Yang Holy Body, otherwise I would have been nailed to the pillar of shame as a time traveler."
Lin Mo was secretly happy.
Although he is already over one hundred and ten years old this year, in the world of immortality, one hundred years old is the age of struggle!
Lin Mo firmly believes that as long as he works hard and improves his cultivation level.
Even if I can't go back to what I looked like when I was twenty, I can at least go back to what I looked like when I was middle-aged.
That's enough.
After sorting out his mood, Lin Mo left Zuixian Tower.
"There are still three days left before the ten days Shangguan Qingqing said. It's time to go back and take a rest."
Back at his cabin, Lin Mo couldn't wait to try the power of the seventh level of Qi refining.
It's really not on the same level as the sixth level of Qi Refining.
Just...
Breaking through to the seventh level of Qi refining also made his pockets cleaner than his face.
"If that female devil Liu Ziyan hadn't set a goal of five thousand spirit stones, I really don't know where to get the spirit stones next..."
Half lying on the bedside, Lin Mo thought.
The status of a handyman disciple still has too many restrictions.
Even if Lin Mo wanted to get the spirit stone, he couldn't.
The Chu Sheng Sect has sect tasks to earn spiritual stones, but only inner disciples can take them.
Handymen are not qualified to take on sect tasks.
Not to mention the sect’s experience.
The handyman also wants to participate in sect training? Dreaming!
"In the future, we still have to find ways to get more training resources from Liu Ziyan."
